evidence: Pass 10 batch 3: AutoPay guardrails. Reproduced a real concurrency defect: two schedule workers both completed after reading the same period allowance. Fixed chargeOrderOffSession in payment.service.ts to lock the customer authority row, rerun the existing evaluateAutoPay decision with transaction-scoped reads and reserve a CREATED payment attempt atomically. Provider calls occur after commit. Shared automaticChargesInPeriod now lives in autopay-cap.service.ts; preview and reservation use the same BigInt aggregate, excluding the current retry from double counting. Existing supplier/category scope, dates, consent, card and currency checks are reused. Sources: backend/src/domain/autopay-authority.ts; modules/payments/autopay.service.ts, autopay-cap.service.ts, payment.service.ts; modules/recurring/occurrence.service.ts; customer pages/AutoPayPage.tsx and lib/autopay.ts. Actual targeted commands: npx vitest run tests/integration/autopay.test.ts tests/integration/autopay-authority-http.test.ts tests/integration/scheduled-orders.test.ts (3 files /128 tests); npx vitest run src/pages/AutoPayPage.test.tsx --config ../../output/pass10-customer.config.mts (1/10). New worker regression synchronizes two real preview decisions: one 236000-minor-unit charge completes inside a 400000 cap; the second gets ACTION_REQUIRED/AUTOPAY_PERIOD_CAP_REACHED, a linked withholding audit, and worker replay makes no additional charge. Two new UI tests prove one click sends POST {paused:true/false} and reflects server state. Negative/boundary coverage includes signed-out refusal, foreign card/customer isolation, missing consent, fresh confirmation/MFA, expiry boundary, period reset, failed/manual/other-customer charges excluded, outside/missing supplier/category scope, invalid cap/currency/date, paused worker makes no order/charge, over-threshold customer approval and pre-charge notice of charge versus hold. Full backend npm run verify: 337 files /5350 tests, typecheck/lint passed. Full customer typecheck/lint/contrast, 196 files /1802 tests and build passed. Fresh admin full verification 52/382, typecheck/lint/contrast/build passed. Reference docs check rerun passed. This correctness fix enforces the cap already documented in the English/Hinglish guides, PRD and feature guide; no public API, schema, configuration, business authorization rule or translated text was added. Active guides/storefront/branding/supplier work remains untouched. Limitations: synthetic local payment provider; no production integration or bank validation claim. The concurrency fixture seeds an existing order-number sequence to isolate the cap; first-ever sequence bootstrap race was separately observed and is recorded in review-notes.md.
